description: Extension of VoiceWakeOverlayController providing methods for session management, UI updates, and interaction handling in a macOS Voice Wake overlay component.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and starts a voice session with given parameters, updates the UI and logs the event.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session state including token, source, text, and visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the session with partial transcript, resets state and updates UI.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Completes and presents the final transcript, optionally schedules auto-send, and handles UI updates.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Marks that user has begun editing, cancels auto-send, updates UI state.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels editing session, stops auto-send, and dismisses the overlay UI.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the displayed text and refreshes UI accordingly.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Initiates the UI send process, plays optional chime, updates state, and schedules dismissal.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests to send the current session/transcript via the shared coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay UI with animation, updates states, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual representation of voice level, with rate limiting.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to determine if the token matches current active token for concurrency control.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an auto-send task after a specified delay, cancellable if needed.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with styling for display.
